fireside.speaker: A man, maybe 60s, with ink-stained fingers
fireside.text: "17 wood. We need 350. The forest isn't going to cut itself."

fireside.speaker: Mara
fireside.text: "Stone. We need 47 more for the palisade footings. Creek beds, hillsides — pry it loose."

fireside.speaker: Vikram
fireside.text: "475 wood. We need 500. The forest isn't going to cut itself."

fireside.speaker: Cameron
fireside.text: "Did you see their faces? Too many angles. I keep wondering what they want from us."

fireside.speaker: Mateo
fireside.text: "The table's set. The ring of pale light — it's just sitting there. Waiting on them. What do you think they'll tell it?"

fireside.speaker: Adaeze
fireside.text: "Did you see their faces? Too many angles. I keep wondering what they want from us."

fireside.speaker: Nadia
fireside.text: "It eats while we deliberate. The Herald feeds on our stores and we're supposed to just... wait?"

fireside.speaker: Mara
fireside.text: "Nobody's sleeping. The sky is waiting and nobody knows what to do with their hands."

fireside.speaker: Nadia
fireside.text: "Why them? ...Sorry. It's just sitting there, and they're the one who has to sit in it."

tableLines.line: 👂 Overheard — A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm (to Mateo): "the man in his 60s, with a farmer's tan's story has a fresh coat of paint." A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm taps the table. "Scrape it off and you get from Helsinki, Finland. Just don't scrape it in front of them."
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Ellis speaks at Stonebridge's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
◈ THE TABLE IS SET. A ring of pale light waits — take your seat from Haven when you are ready. Nothing is final until you sit.

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and

The little star inside Ellis goes quiet — and wakes up inside Cameron. Ellis never got hungry while the village did, so the pellet moved to hungrier hands: Cameron will never be hungry again while it hums, and Ellis is hungry again, for the first time in a long while. The table can hear a feast again.

◈ OVERTIME ×1 — wave 4–5 monsters return as RERUNS (+25% HP, +12% damage). Raids come sooner. The table docks your standing −7. Take your seat from Haven to stop the clock. The wait stretches — the village's standing buys time: 23 days between tiers, not 7.
You caught the lie in his face and watched the whole table react to it before he'd finished the sentence. Face and room, both open books.

◈ OVERTIME ×2 — wave 4–5 monsters return as RERUNS (+50% HP, +24% damage, +1 to every pack). Raids come sooner. The table docks your standing −23. Take your seat from Haven to stop the clock. The wait stretches — the village's standing buys time: 22 days between tiers, not 7.
◈ THE TRIBUTE — Mara and Xavier walk out of Haven in the table's service, two fighters the galaxy asked for by name. The village is smaller tonight. The seat is open.
◈ THE TABLE — between now and the seat, the world holds its breath. Nothing out there can take this from you.
